answer: Onyx-summit layered bond: each identity locks 70 credits on the onyx ledger, growing five layers to the summit, one per honest epoch. A beacon checks each layer; forgery burns the bond. Layers bind to one key; shared layers burn both. Five layers cost the k-th identity 30+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,027,000 + 70,000 locked, vs 40,000. A rented-layer ring fails: copied layer hashes on the onyx ledger flag both bonds. Honest agents pay once.
